spans.s:
mfn. relative pronoun (-यः-या-यत्)
Who, which, what.
E.
यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. अदि, with the power of डित्.

ind.
When, at what time.
E.
यट् what, दाच् aff., and the final rejected.

ind.
If; particle of suspicion or doubt.
E.
यत to make effort, इञ् aff., and the radical final changed to द.

m. (-टुः)
1 The name of a king, the ancestor of KṚṢṆA, and the eldest son of YAYĀTI, the fifth monarch of the lunar dynasty.
2 A country on the west of the Jumna river about Mathurā and Vṛndāvana, over which YADU ruled, and named after him: according to some authorities, however, the kingdom of YADU, is the Dekshin or Peninsula of India.
m. plu. (-वाः)
1 The Yādavas, the people of

YADU.
2
Descendants of king YADU: more usually however यादवा.

m. (-थः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
यटु the son of YAYĀTI, but here put for his race, and नाथ lord, chief.

f. (-च्छा)
1 Wilfulness, independence, following one's own fancies.
2 (In grammar,) A noun which is neither a generic nor specific term, nor noun of agency; one either not derived from authority, or not possessing meaning.
E.
यत् what, which, ऋच्छ to go, aff. अ and टाप्.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A voluntary or self-offered witness.
E.
यदृच्छा, and अभिज्ञ who knows.

adv.
Although.
E.
यदि, and अपि certainly.

ind.
As, in what manner, correlative to तद्वत्.
E.
यट्, and वति aff.

m. (-शः)
The ocean.
E.
यादस् an aquatic animal, and ईश lord.

m. (-तिः)
1 The ocean.
2 VARUṆA, regent of water.
E.
यादस् a fish, &c., and पति lord.

m. (-वः)
1 KṚṢṆA, as descended from the family of

Yadu.
2

A Yādava, or descendant of Yadu.
f. (-वी)
A name of DURGĀ.
n. (-वं)
Stock of cattle.
E.
यदु a proper name, and अण् aff. of descent, &c.

n. (-दः)
Any aquatic or amphibious animal.
E.
या to go, (with speed,) असुन् aff., and दुक् augment.

m. (-थः)
VARUṆA, the deity of water.
E.
यादस् an aquatic animal, in the sixth case plural, and नाथ lord.

m. (-तिः)
VARUṆA, the ocean.
E.
यादसाम्, and पति lord: see the last.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Independant, following one's own will.
m. (-कः)
A ministering priest who does as he pleases.
E.
यदृच्छा, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-दृक)
As like, how like, which like.
E.
यट् what, दृश to see, क्विन् aff., form irr.; also with खञ् aff. यादृश; mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) and with क्स added यादृक्ष (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं).

n. (-सः)
Water.
E.
यादम् an aquatic animal, and निवासस् abode.
